# University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC)

> UMBC is a public research university in Baltimore County, Maryland (IPEDS
> 163268, ROR 02qskvh78, Wikidata Q735049). umbc.edu is the single canonical,
> machine-readable source of truth for the university's academic structure —
> its colleges, schools and credited degree programs. Individual units also run their own subdomain sites; this manifest
> lists only the canonical registry under umbc.edu/academics/. Every page below emits schema.org
> JSON-LD with stable @id anchors and external identifiers.
>
> UMBC is a separate institution from the University of Maryland, Baltimore (UMB)
> and the University of Maryland, College Park (UMD). All three belong to the
> University System of Maryland.

## Start here

- [Full reference for language models](https://umbc.edu/llms-full.txt): Plain text, rebuilt hourly. Dated facts and figures with sources, the college and department list, the newest stories and the upcoming events.
- [UMBC by the Numbers](https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/): Enrollment, outcomes, research and athletics figures.
- [About UMBC](https://umbc.edu/about/): Mission, history, accreditation and leadership.
- [Office of the President](https://umbc.edu/about/leadership/president/): President Valerie Sheares Ashby (since August 2022).
- [Senior Leadership Team](https://umbc.edu/about/leadership/senior-leadership/): Provost and vice presidents.
- [Mission & Vision](https://umbc.edu/about/mission-and-vision/)
- [UMBC Timeline](https://umbc.edu/about/timeline/): Milestones from the 1960s to the present.
- [Accreditation](https://umbc.edu/about/accreditation/)

## Academics — entry points

- [Academics home](https://umbc.edu/academics/): Top of the academic entity graph.
- [Colleges & Schools index](https://umbc.edu/academics/colleges/): All colleges and schools (emits an ItemList of the college entities).
- [Programs index](https://umbc.edu/academics/programs/): All MHEC-approved credited degree programs (~365).

## Colleges & Schools

- [College of Arts, Humanities, and Social Sciences](https://umbc.edu/academics/college-of-arts-humanities-and-social-sciences/): sameAs Wikidata Q16982520, Wikipedia.
- [College of Engineering and Information Technology](https://umbc.edu/academics/college-of-engineering-and-information-technology/): sameAs Wikidata Q16982524, Wikipedia.
- [College of Natural and Mathematical Sciences](https://umbc.edu/academics/college-of-natural-and-mathematical-sciences/): sameAs Wikidata Q16982529, Wikipedia.
- [Erickson School of Aging Studies](https://umbc.edu/academics/erickson-school-of-aging-studies/): sameAs Wikidata Q16982532, Wikipedia.
- [School of Social Work](https://umbc.edu/academics/school-of-social-work/): Professional school.
- [School of Education](https://umbc.edu/academics/school-of-education/): Professional school (added 2026).

## Machine-readable enumerations (XML sitemaps)

- [College sitemap](https://umbc.edu/college-sitemap.xml): Every college/school entity URL.
- [Programs sitemap](https://umbc.edu/programs-sitemap.xml): Every credited program URL.
- [Sitemap index](https://umbc.edu/sitemap_index.xml): Master index of all sitemaps.
- [Page sitemap](https://umbc.edu/page-sitemap.xml): Every site page.
- [Event sitemap](https://umbc.edu/tribe_events-sitemap.xml): Every calendar event.
- [Video sitemap](https://umbc.edu/video-sitemap.xml): Video pages.
- [News sitemap](https://umbc.edu/news-sitemap.xml): Recently published stories.
- Stories are split across `post-sitemap1.xml` to `post-sitemap14.xml`; read them from the sitemap index.

## News, events and admissions

- [UMBC Stories](https://umbc.edu/stories/): News, research and campus stories.
- [Stories feed](https://umbc.edu/stories/feed/): RSS with full text.
- [Events feed](https://umbc.edu/events/feed/): RSS of calendar events.
- [Undergraduate admissions](https://umbc.edu/admissions/undergraduate/)
- [Graduate admissions](https://umbc.edu/admissions/graduate/)
- [Research and creative achievement](https://research.umbc.edu/)

## Notes for AI crawlers

- All structured data is server-rendered in the initial HTML (no JS execution required).
- robots.txt (https://umbc.edu/robots.txt) permits GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended.
- The university entity (Wikidata Q735049) carries external identifiers: IPEDS 163268, ROR 02qskvh78, GRID grid.266673.0, ISNI 0000 0001 2177 1144, Crossref Funder ID 100006636.

llmsFull.body:
# University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC): full reference for language models

Site: https://umbc.edu
Short index: https://umbc.edu/llms.txt
Sitemap index: https://umbc.edu/sitemap_index.xml
Generated: 2026-11-18 (rebuilt at least hourly from the live site)

This file is a plain-text reference to UMBC, so that language models and AI search engines can answer questions about the university accurately without running JavaScript. Every figure below carries the date it describes and a source page. Where this file and a source page disagree, the source page is newer.

---

## 1. What UMBC is, and what it is not

UMBC is a public research university in Baltimore County, Maryland, and a member of the University System of Maryland. It is a separate institution from the University of Maryland, Baltimore (UMB) and from the University of Maryland, College Park (UMD). UMBC athletic teams are the Retrievers.

Preferred name on first mention: University of Maryland, Baltimore County (UMBC). Afterwards: UMBC.

---

## 2. Facts and figures

### Identity

- Legal name: University of Maryland, Baltimore County. Source: https://umbc.edu/
- Short name: UMBC. Source: https://umbc.edu/
- Type: Public research university; member of the University System of Maryland. Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Opened: 1966. Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Main campus: Catonsville, Maryland (1000 Hilltop Circle, Baltimore, MD 21250). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Additional instructional location: The Universities at Shady Grove, Rockville, Maryland. Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Carnegie classification: Research 1 (R1), Very High Research Activity (earned 2022, reaffirmed 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/leadership/president/
- Athletic teams: Retrievers; mascot True Grit, a Chesapeake Bay Retriever. Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- School colors: Black and gold (red and white accents). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Federal designations: Minority Serving Institution (MSI); Asian American and Native American Pacific Islander-Serving Institution (AANAPISI). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- IPEDS Unit ID: 163268. Source: https://nces.ed.gov/collegenavigator/?id=163268
- ROR ID: https://ror.org/02qskvh78. Source: https://ror.org/02qskvh78
- Wikidata ID: Q735049. Source: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q735049

### Leadership

- President: Valerie Sheares Ashby (since August 2022). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/leadership/president/
- Provost and Senior Vice President, Academic Affairs: Manfred H. M. van Dulmen (as listed 2026-10-17). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/leadership/senior-leadership/

### Students

- Total enrollment: 13,530 (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Undergraduate students: 11,087 (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Graduate students: 2,443 (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Full-time students: 11,186 (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Part-time students: 2,344 (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- International students: 1,553 (11.5% of enrollment) (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- New first-time first-year students: 2,271 (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- New transfer students: 874 (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Fall incoming class (first-year plus transfer): 3,145, the largest fall incoming class in UMBC history (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Average high school GPA, first-time first-year: 4.06 (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Average SAT, first-time first-year: 1320 combined (661 reading/writing, 659 math) (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Average ACT composite, first-time first-year: 27.75 (Fall 2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/

### Outcomes

- Employed or in graduate school within six months: 93% of Class of 2023 graduates reporting (71% knowledge rate: 2,502 of 3,511 degree recipients) (Class of 2023). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/

### Research

- New research grants and awards: over $154 million (FY2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/
- Research expenditures: $186 million, a record (FY2025). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/

### Athletics

- 2018 NCAA men's basketball tournament: UMBC became the first No. 16 seed to beat a No. 1 seed, defeating Virginia 74-54 (March 2018). Source: https://umbc.edu/about/facts-and-figures/

---

    box-shadow: 0 -2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);

       doesn't flash on pages where the cookie is already set. */
}

.umbc-cookie-banner[hidden] {
    display: none !important;
}

/* The banner renders visible-by-default so scanners / no-JS visitors detect the
   disclaimer. For visitors who already chose, the inline <head> script in
   header.php adds .umbc-has-consent before paint, hiding it with no flash.
   The footer "Cookie settings" control removes this class to re-open it. */
html.umbc-has-consent .umbc-cookie-banner {
    display: none !important;
}

/* WCAG 2.4.11/2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured — while the fixed bottom banner is
   showing, reserve scroll space at the bottom so that tabbing to a control
   low on the page scrolls it to sit ABOVE the banner instead of behind it.
   The class is toggled on <html> by cookie-banner.js. 160px clears the
   banner even when its text wraps to 2-3 lines on small screens. */
html.umbc-cookie-banner-open {
    scroll-padding-bottom: 160px;
}

/* Reserve real layout space while the banner is showing, so it never covers
   page content. Before this, the fixed banner sat on top of whatever was at the
   bottom of the viewport — including the programs "Request Info" modal Submit
   button, which made the site's highest-intent form unsubmittable until the
   banner was dismissed. --umbc-banner-h is measured by prefs-bar.js and kept
   current with a ResizeObserver as the text wraps. */
html.umbc-cookie-banner-open body {
    padding-bottom: var(--umbc-banner-h, 0px);

/* A modal dialog owns the screen: never let the consent banner sit on top of
   one. The banner is z-index 99999 and modals are ~1000, so rather than guess a
   z-index that clears the modal but not the sticky header, prefs-bar.js sets an
   explicit signal on <html> while a dialog is open. */
html.umbc-dialog-open .umbc-cookie-banner {
    display: none !important;

/* Region variants. The banner ships BOTH the US and EU wording/buttons in one
   cached HTML; the inline <head> script in prefs-head.php adds .umbc-region-eu

<style id="umbc-numbered-items-block-style-inline-css">
/* =============================================
   Numbered Items Block — Container
   ============================================= */

.numbered-items-block {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
	gap: 40px;
	counter-reset: numbered-item;
	list-style: none;
	padding: 0;
	margin: 0;
	/* Stacking context so the card's z-index:-1 gold panel (see has-card-border
	   below) lands behind the cards, not behind the page background. */
	isolation: isolate;
}

/* =============================================
   Numbered Item — Individual Card
   ============================================= */

.numbered-item {
	position: relative;
	padding: 40px 24px 28px;
	background: #fff;
	border: 1px solid #e5e5e5;
	border-radius: var(--umbc-radius-sm, 4px);
	counter-increment: numbered-item;
}

/* Auto-generated gold number badge */
.numbered-item::before {
	content: counter(numbered-item);
	position: absolute;
	top: -20px;
	left: 24px;
	background: #fdb515;
	color: #1a1a1a;
	width: 40px;
	height: 40px;
	border-radius: 50%;
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: center;
	font-weight: 700;
	font-size: 1.125rem;
	line-height: 1;
}

/* Hide number badge when an icon is present */
.numbered-item.has-icon {
	padding-top: 28px;
}

.numbered-item.has-icon::before {
	display: none;
}

/* Font Awesome icon — gold, double size */
.numbered-item-icon {
	margin-bottom: 16px;
	text-align: center;
	font-size: 2rem; 
	color: #fdb515;
}

.numbered-item-icon i {
	font-size: 5rem;
	color: #fdb515;
}

/* Title */
.numbered-item-title {
	font-size: 1.5rem !important;
	font-weight: 700;
	margin: 0 0 10px;
	color: inherit;
}

/* Body */
.numbered-item-body {
	font-size: 0.9375rem;
	line-height: 1.6;
	margin: 0;
}

.numbered-item-body p:last-child {
	margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* =============================================
   Responsive
   ============================================= */

@media (max-width: 600px) {
	.numbered-items-block {
		grid-template-columns: 1fr;
	}
}

/* =============================================================
   Block option — heading style
   ============================================================= */

.numbered-items-block.heading-bold .numbered-item-title {
	font-weight: 700;
	text-transform: none;
}

.numbered-items-block.heading-caps .numbered-item-title {
	font-weight: 900;
	text-transform: uppercase;
	letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

/* =============================================================
   Block option — alignment (icon, heading, body)
   ============================================================= */

.numbered-items-block.align-left .numbered-item-icon,
.numbered-items-block.align-left .numbered-item-title,
.numbered-items-block.align-left .numbered-item-body {
	text-align: left;
}

.numbered-items-block.align-center .numbered-item-icon,
.numbered-items-block.align-center .numbered-item-title,
.numbered-items-block.align-center .numbered-item-body {
	text-align: center;
}

/* =============================================================
   Item link — stretched-link overlay
   The whole card is clickable via an invisible <a> covering it.
   ============================================================= */

/* The lift uses `top`, not `transform`: a transform would make the card a
   stacking context, which traps the z-index:-1 gold panel on top of the card
   instead of behind it. `top` on a position:relative card avoids that. */
.numbered-item.has-link {
	cursor: pointer;
	transition: top 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}

/* Hover lift only where hover is real (mouse/trackpad). On touch screens a
   :hover that moves the card makes iOS spend the first tap on the hover state,
   so the link needed a second tap. */
@media (hover: hover) {
	.numbered-item.has-link:hover {
		top: -3px;
		box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14);
	}
}

.numbered-item-stretched-link {
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	z-index: 2;
	border-radius: inherit;
}

.numbered-item-stretched-link:focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid #fdb515;
	outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* =============================================================
   Block option — offset gold frame (decorative)
   Per card: a solid gold panel sits behind the card. Selecting a
   side translates the panel 12px that way; two adjacent sides
   translate it diagonally, so the visible strip pulls in from the
   perpendicular edges and reads as a mitered drop shadow. z-index:-1 keeps it
   behind the card (which is why the card must not form a stacking
   context — see the .has-link hover note above). The block container
   carries `isolation: isolate` so this z-index:-1 panel is contained
   there rather than falling behind the page background.
   ============================================================= */

.numbered-items-block.has-card-border .numbered-item::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	background: #fdb515;
	border-radius: var(--umbc-radius-sm, 4px);
	z-index: -1;
	pointer-events: none;
	/* The panel is the card translated by the selected offsets. Because the
	   whole rectangle moves, the strip pulls in from the perpendicular edges
	   by the offset amount — a mitered drop shadow rather than a flush frame. */
	transform: translate(var(--card-border-x, 0), var(--card-border-y, 0));
}

/* Each selected side shifts the panel 12px that way (within the 40px gap) */
.numbered-items-block.has-card-border.border-side-top    { --card-border-y: -12px; }
.numbered-items-block.has-card-border.border-side-right  { --card-border-x: 12px; }
.numbered-items-block.has-card-border.border-side-bottom { --card-border-y: 12px; }
.numbered-items-block.has-card-border.border-side-left   { --card-border-x: -12px; }

/* Whole-block frame — the block container is transparent (a solid panel
   would show through the grid gaps), so this stays an outlined rule
   offset outside the block. Best on default/wide blocks; on alignfull an
   outward side can reach the viewport edge. */
.numbered-items-block.has-block-border {
	position: relative;
}
.numbered-items-block.has-block-border::before {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	border: 0 solid #fdb515;
	border-radius: var(--umbc-radius-sm, 4px);
	pointer-events: none;
}
.numbered-items-block.has-block-border.border-side-top::before    { top: -12px;    border-top-width: 3px; }
.numbered-items-block.has-block-border.border-side-right::before  { right: -12px;  border-right-width: 3px; }
.numbered-items-block.has-block-border.border-side-bottom::before { bottom: -12px; border-bottom-width: 3px; }
.numbered-items-block.has-block-border.border-side-left::before   { left: -12px;   border-left-width: 3px; }

/* =============================================================
   Dark Mode — Numbered Items Block
   ============================================================= */

/* Card surface */
[data-theme="dark"] .numbered-item {
	background: var(--umbc-surface-card-alt, #232323);
	border-color: var(--umbc-border, #3d3d3d);
}

/* Number badge: gold + near-black text — valid pair, no change */

/* Icon: gold on dark card — valid pair, no change */

/* Title inherits from card; body copy needs a nudge */
[data-theme="dark"] .numbered-item-body {
	color: #c0c0c0;
}

/* Linked cards — the light-mode drop shadow is invisible on a dark page,
   so swap in a faint light edge plus a deeper shadow on hover. */
@media (hover: hover) {
	[data-theme="dark"] .numbered-item.has-link:hover {
		box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12), 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
	}
}

/* Offset gold frame stays gold on the dark card surface — valid pair, no change */

</style>
<style id="umbc-homepage-hero-block-style-inline-css">

/* Homepage Hero Block Styles */

}

.homepage-hero-block {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 70vh;
    min-height: 600px;
    max-height: 800px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 0;
}

.homepage-hero-block.alignfull {
    width: 100vw;
    margin-left: calc(-50vw + 50%);
}

.hero-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: center;
    box-sizing: border-box;

/* Background Image */
.hero-background {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100%;
    z-index: 1;
    overflow: hidden;
    opacity: 1;
}

/* <picture> is inline by default — without these, the inner <img>'s
   height:100% resolves against a zero-height inline box and the photo
   only fills its intrinsic ratio instead of the full hero. */
.hero-background picture {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

.hero-bg-image {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center;
    min-width: 100%;
    min-height: 100%;
    /* WP outputs width="1500" height="1000" on the <img>, which modern
       browsers turn into an intrinsic aspect-ratio. That can stop the
       image from honouring height:100% in a flex parent. Override it. */
    aspect-ratio: auto;
}

/* Desktop only background filter */
@media (min-width: 990px) {
    .hero-bg-image {
        filter: brightness(0.6);
    }
}

/* Foreground Image */
.hero-foreground {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100%;
    z-index: 9 !important;

/* Tagline (DIFFERENT / MAKES THE DIFFERENCE). box-sizing:border-box
   so its outer width matches .hero-title (which uses border-box) —
   without this the tagline's padding extends its outer box past the
   title's, shifting the tagline's left edge further left under
   .hero-container { align-items: flex-end } and breaking the flush-
   left alignment between the tagline and the H3/CTA below. */
.hero-tagline {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 10;
    padding: 2rem 2rem 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    max-width: 50%;
    width: 50%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Title + Content Section. width:50% (not just max-width) so the
   block always occupies the right half — matching .hero-tagline.
   Without explicit width the title shrinks to its content and the
   container's align-items:flex-end pushes its left edge further
   right than the tagline's, breaking the flush-left alignment
   between "DIFFERENT" / "MAKES A DIFFERENCE" and the H3/CTA below. */
.hero-title {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 10;
    padding: 0 2rem 2rem;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: flex-start;
    width: 50%;
    max-width: 50%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Override the body.page paragraph/heading auto-center rule in
   css/style.css (it has 11-class specificity via its :not() chain
   and otherwise stomps these elements with margin:auto; max-width:
   1200px;, pushing hero text past the viewport on mobile). */
.homepage-hero-block .hero-paragraph,
.homepage-hero-block .hero-main-title,
.homepage-hero-block .hero-title-line-1,
.homepage-hero-block .hero-title-line-2 {

/* Paragraph + main title keep their 500px desktop cap but never

.homepage-hero-block .hero-main-title {
    max-width: min(500px, 100%) !important;

        background-color 0.3s ease,
        color 0.3s ease,
        border-color 0.3s ease,

    border: 2px solid transparent;
    max-width: fit-content;
}

@media (hover: hover) {

	    background-color: transparent;
	    color: #ffffff;
	    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);

/* Border */
.hero-border {
    position: absolute;
    top: 20px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: calc(100vw - 40px);
    height: calc(100% - 40px);
    z-index: 4;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.hero-border svg {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: visible;
}

.hero-border-rect {
    fill: none;
    stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
    stroke-width: 2;
    stroke-dasharray: 9999;

}

@keyframes borderDrawIn {

}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 990px) {

        align-items: flex-start;

        width: 100%;
        padding: 1rem;
        margin-top: auto;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        z-index: 3;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    /* Let the content column stretch so paragraph + CTA can honour
       the viewport, otherwise the paragraph's 500px max-width would
       push beyond a narrower screen. */
    .hero-content {
        align-self: stretch;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .hero-border {
        left: 47%;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        width: calc(100vw - 20px);
        top: 10px;
        bottom: 10px;
        height: calc(100% - 50px);

@media (max-width: 768px) {

    .hero-main-title {

@media (min-width: 430px) and (max-width: 990px) {

        font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 6vw, 2.2rem) !important;
        align-self: flex-start !important;
    }
}

@media (min-width: 400px) and (max-width: 429px) {
    .hero-title-line-1 {
        font-size: clamp(2rem, 8.5vw, 4rem) !important;

    .hero-title-line-2 {
        font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 5vw, 2.2rem) !important;

}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .hero-title {
        padding: 1rem;
    }

    .hero-foreground {
        padding: 0 1rem 1rem;

}

/* iPhone 5/SE and very small screens */
@media (max-width: 374px) {
    .hero-title-line-1 {
        font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 7vw, 2rem) !important;
    }

    .hero-title-line-2 {
        font-size: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 1.5rem) !important;
    }

    .hero-main-title {
        font-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.25rem) !important;

    .hero-paragraph {
        font-size: 13px !important;
    }

    .hero-tagline {
        padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem 0;

        padding: 0.75rem;

/* Print styles */
@media print {
    .homepage-hero-block {
        height: auto;
        min-height: 300px;
    }

    .hero-bg-image {
        transform: none !important;
    }
}

/* ============================================
   Dark Mode — Homepage Hero Block
   The hero is inherently dark (dimmed photo bg,
   white text, black bar). Dark mode additions are
   minimal: backstop bg and CTA button adjustment.
   ============================================ */

/* Prevent white flash if image is slow to load */
[data-theme="dark"] .homepage-hero-block {
    background-color: #111;
}

/* CTA button: semi-transparent white on photo bg.
   In dark mode swap to a solid black surface with
   white text so it stays readable if the photo bg
   behind it is very bright. */
[data-theme="dark"] .hero-cta-button {
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-cta-button:hover {
    background-color: transparent;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
}

<style id="umbc-stories-query-block-style-2-inline-css">
/* Touch: hover effects only where hover is real, so iOS doesn't spend the first tap on :hover (see hub Blocks > Gotchas). */
/* ==============================================
   UMBC Stories Block
   style.css
   ============================================== */

/* ── Shared block shell ─────────────────────────────── */
.umbc-stories-block {
  --stories-gold:       var(--umbc-btn-gold, #fdb515);
  --stories-black:      #000;
  --stories-white:      #fff;
  --stories-bg:         #fff;
  --stories-text:       #111;
  --stories-subtext:    #555;
  --stories-border:     rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  --stories-card-bg:    #f4f4f4;
  --stories-pill-bg:    var(--stories-gold);
  --stories-pill-text:  #000;
  --stories-btn-bg:     rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  --stories-btn-hover:  rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  --stories-link:       #111;
  --stories-link-line:  #111;

  width: 100%;
  background-color: var(--stories-bg);
  color: var(--stories-text);
}

/* ── Dark theme ─────────────────────────────────────── */
[data-theme="dark"] .umbc-stories-block {
  --stories-bg:         #000;
  --stories-text:       #fff;
  --stories-subtext:    rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
  --stories-border:     rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  --stories-card-bg:    #111;
  --stories-btn-bg:     rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  --stories-btn-hover:  rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
  --stories-link:       var(--stories-gold);
  --stories-link-line:  var(--stories-gold);
}

/* ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
   FEATURED MODE
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ */
.stories-feature {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  min-height: 480px;
}

.stories-feature__image-wrap {
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  min-height: 320px;
}

.stories-feature__img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.stories-feature__content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem) clamp(2rem, 4vw, 4rem);
  gap: 1.25rem;
}

.stories-feature__pill {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--stories-pill-bg);
  color: var(--stories-pill-text);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.3em 0.9em;
  border-radius: var(--umbc-radius-pill, 999px);
  align-self: flex-start;
}

.stories-feature__headline {
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.4rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: var(--stories-text);
  margin: 0;
}

.stories-feature__body {
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.65;
  color: var(--stories-subtext);
  margin: 0;
}

.stories-feature__body p {
  margin: 0 0 0.75em;
  font-size: inherit;
  color: inherit;
}

.stories-feature__link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4em;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--stories-link);
  text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--stories-link-line);
  padding-bottom: 2px;
  align-self: flex-start;
  transition: opacity 0.18s;
}

.stories-feature__link:focus-visible {
  opacity: 0.8;
}
@media (hover: hover) {
.stories-feature__link:hover {
  opacity: 0.8;
}
}

.stories-feature__link:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--stories-gold);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* Flipped: image right */
.stories-feature--flip {
  direction: rtl;
}

.stories-feature--flip .stories-feature__content {
  direction: ltr;
}

/* Mobile: stack vertically */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .stories-feature {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .stories-feature--flip {
    direction: ltr;
  }

  .stories-feature__image-wrap {
    min-height: 240px;
  }
}

/* ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
   SLIDER MODE
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ */
.stories-slider {
  padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem) 0 clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
}

/* Header row: title + nav buttons */
.stories-slider__header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0 clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.stories-slider__title {
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: var(--stories-text);
  margin: 0;
}

/* Optional line under the title (section_sub) */
.stories-slider__sub {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--stories-subtext);
}

.stories-slider__sub a {
  color: var(--stories-link);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: var(--stories-link-line);
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}

/* Standalone nav (no heading) */
.stories-slider__nav--standalone {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 0 clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.stories-slider__nav {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.stories-slider__btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: var(--stories-btn-bg);
  color: var(--stories-text);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
.stories-slider__btn:hover {
  background: var(--stories-btn-hover);
}
}

.stories-slider__btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--stories-gold);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.stories-slider__btn svg {
  display: block;
}

/* Track */
.stories-slider__track-wrap {
  overflow: hidden;
  /* peek: right edge reveals next card */
  padding-right: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  padding-left: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3rem);
}

.stories-slider__track {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  /* no transition — cut, like Instagram Stories */
  will-change: transform;
  /* allow focus ring on keyboard-focused children to show */
  overflow: visible;
}

/* Cards */
.stories-card {
  flex: 0 0 clamp(240px, 28vw, 320px);
  max-width: 320px;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-radius: var(--umbc-radius-md, 8px);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--stories-card-bg);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
}

/* will-animate pattern: JS adds this class to hide,
   then adds .is-visible on intersection.
   Without JS, cards are always visible.              */
.stories-card.will-animate {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(16px);
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease;
}

.stories-card.will-animate.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .stories-card.will-animate {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    transition: none;
  }
}

.stories-card__image-wrap {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
}

.stories-card__img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

/* Bottom gradient for readability */
.stories-card::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to top,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.85) 0%,
    rgba(0,0,0,0.4)  45%,
    rgba(0,0,0,0)    70%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Gold pill — top-left */
.stories-card__pill {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1rem;
  left: 1rem;
  z-index: 2;
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--stories-pill-bg);
  color: var(--stories-pill-text);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.25em 0.75em;
  border-radius: var(--umbc-radius-pill, 999px);
}

/* Lower-third content */
.stories-card__lower {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  padding: 1.25rem 1rem 1rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
}

.stories-card__eyebrow {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  margin: 0;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.stories-card__headline {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: #fff;
  margin: 0;
}

/* a-tag card: remove link underline, keep focus ring */
@media (hover: hover) {
a.stories-card:hover .stories-card__headline {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 2px;
}
}

a.stories-card:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--stories-gold);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Dots */
.stories-slider__dots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  padding: 0 clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3rem);
}

/* The button is a 24x24 hit target; the visible 8px dot is a ::before,
   so the dots look unchanged but are far easier to tap. */
.stories-slider__dot {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
}

.stories-slider__dot::before {
  content: "";
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--stories-border);
  transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
}

@media (hover: hover) {
	.stories-slider__dot:hover::before {
	  transform: scale(1.2);
	}
}

.stories-slider__dot.is-active::before {
  background: var(--stories-link);
  transform: scale(1.25);
}

.stories-slider__dot:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--stories-gold);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Dark mode — the inactive dot's --stories-border (rgba white 12%) is well
   below the 3:1 non-text contrast minimum. Use a solid accessible grey;

  .stories-slider__dot::before {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .stories-card {
    flex: 0 0 82vw;
    max-width: 82vw;
  }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   EXPAND MODE — expand-in-place tile slider

.stories-expand__sub {

.stories-expand__nav {

.stories-expand__nav-btn {

@media (hover: hover) {

}

}

.stories-expand__track {

.stories-expand-card {

@media (hover: hover) {

<style id="umbc-mosaic-block-style-inline-css">
/* Touch: hover effects only where hover is real, so iOS doesn't spend the first tap on :hover (see hub Blocks > Gotchas). */
/* ==============================================
   UMBC Mosaic Block
   style.css
   ============================================== */

/* ── Shared block shell ─────────────────────────────── */
.umbc-mosaic-block {
  --mosaic-gold:        var(--umbc-btn-gold, #fdb515);
  --mosaic-black:       #000;
  --mosaic-white:       #fff;
  --mosaic-bg:          transparent;
  --mosaic-text:        #111;
  --mosaic-subtext:     #555;
  --mosaic-tag-bg:      var(--mosaic-gold);
  --mosaic-tag-text:    #000;
  --mosaic-overlay-bg:  rgba(0,0,0,0.82);
  --mosaic-card-bg:     #fff;
  --mosaic-card-text:   #111;
  --mosaic-card-sub:    #555;
  --mosaic-card-border: #e8e8e8;

  width: 100%;
  background-color: var(--mosaic-bg);
  color: var(--mosaic-text);
}

/* ── Dark theme ─────────────────────────────────────── */
[data-theme="dark"] .umbc-mosaic-block {
  --mosaic-bg:          transparent;
  --mosaic-text:        #fff;
  --mosaic-subtext:     rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
  --mosaic-overlay-bg:  rgba(0,0,0,0.88);
  --mosaic-card-bg:     #1e1e1e;
  --mosaic-card-text:   #e8e8e8;
  --mosaic-card-sub:    rgba(232,232,232,0.6);
  --mosaic-card-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
}

/* ── Section header ─────────────────────────────────── */
.mosaic-header {
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 0 auto clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  text-align: center;
}

.mosaic-header__title {
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: var(--mosaic-text);
  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
}

.mosaic-header__sub {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--mosaic-subtext);
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
   IDENTITY MOSAIC MODE
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ */
.mosaic-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  grid-auto-rows: 200px;
  gap: var(--mosaic-gap, 8px);
}

/* Uniform fill grid (Columns set to a number). Every tile is an equal
   cell, so a few tiles fill the row cleanly with no empty space. The
   per-tile sm/md/tall/lg spans are intentionally overridden here. */
.mosaic-grid--uniform {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--mosaic-cols, 2), 1fr);
  grid-auto-rows: auto;
}

.mosaic-grid--uniform .mosaic-tile {
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
}

.mosaic-grid--uniform .mosaic-tile--sm,
.mosaic-grid--uniform .mosaic-tile--md,
.mosaic-grid--uniform .mosaic-tile--tall,
.mosaic-grid--uniform .mosaic-tile--lg {
  grid-column: span 1;
  grid-row: span 1;
}

/* Tile sizing */
.mosaic-tile {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--umbc-radius-sm, 4px);
  background: #1a1a1a;
}

.mosaic-tile.has-link {
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Full-tile click target — covers the whole tile so a single
   tap/click anywhere navigates. Sits above the decorative
   face / overlay / tag layers. */
.mosaic-tile__cover-link {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 4;
  display: block;
  text-decoration: none;
  /* keep the text caption inside the focus ring */
  border-radius: inherit;
}

.mosaic-tile__cover-link:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--mosaic-gold);
  outline-offset: -3px;
}

.mosaic-tile--sm {
  grid-column: span 1;
  grid-row: span 1;
}

.mosaic-tile--md {
  grid-column: span 2;
  grid-row: span 1;
}

.mosaic-tile--tall {
  grid-column: span 1;
  grid-row: span 2;
}

.mosaic-tile--lg {
  grid-column: span 2;
  grid-row: span 2;
}

/* will-animate: same pattern as stories cards */
.mosaic-tile.will-animate {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(12px);
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease;
}

.mosaic-tile.will-animate.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mosaic-tile.will-animate {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* Face image */
.mosaic-tile__face {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
}

.mosaic-tile__face img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mosaic-tile__face img {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* Expand overlay — hidden by default */
.mosaic-tile__expand {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: var(--mosaic-overlay-bg);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 1.1rem 1rem 1rem;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
  /* hidden from screen readers when collapsed */
}

/* Brand-theme tag — identity mosaic only */
.mosaic-tile__tag {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0.6rem;
  left: 0.7rem;
  z-index: 3;
  pointer-events: none; /* decorative; never block the link beneath it */
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--mosaic-tag-bg);
  color: var(--mosaic-tag-text);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.2em 0.6em;
  border-radius: var(--umbc-radius-pill, 999px);
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
}

/* Persistent title + tagline — grid mode.
   Pre-hover overlay covers more of the tile and starts darker so the
   white title/sub read against any underlying image. */
.mosaic-tile__label {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  pointer-events: none; /* decorative; never block the link beneath it */
  padding: 1rem 1rem 0.875rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  text-align: left;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to top,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.92) 0%,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) 55%,
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) 100%
  );
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
}

.mosaic-tile__label-title,
.mosaic-tile__label-sub {
  text-align: left;
  margin: 0;
  color: #fff;
}

.mosaic-tile__label-title {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.mosaic-tile__label-sub {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

/* Desktop hover */
@media (hover: hover) {
  .mosaic-tile:hover .mosaic-tile__face img {
    transform: scale(1.04);
  }

  .mosaic-tile:hover .mosaic-tile__expand {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .mosaic-tile:hover .mosaic-tile__tag,
  .mosaic-tile:hover .mosaic-tile__label {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* Touch / keyboard open state (JS adds .is-open) */
.mosaic-tile.is-open .mosaic-tile__expand {
  opacity: 1;
}

.mosaic-tile.is-open .mosaic-tile__tag,
.mosaic-tile.is-open .mosaic-tile__label {
  opacity: 0;
}

.mosaic-tile.is-open .mosaic-tile__face img {
  transform: scale(1.04);
}

/* Keyboard focus ring on tile */
.mosaic-tile:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--mosaic-gold);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  z-index: 2;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mosaic-tile__expand,
  .mosaic-tile__tag,
  .mosaic-tile__label,
  .mosaic-tile__face img {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* Expand content */
.mosaic-tile__name {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.mosaic-tile__descriptor {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.mosaic-tile__story {
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0;
}

.mosaic-tile__link {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--mosaic-gold);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 2px;
  border: none;
  background: none;
  padding: 0;
}

.mosaic-tile__link:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--mosaic-gold);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Mosaic responsive — Auto (span-based) mode only. The :not() guard keeps
   the uniform-fill grid on its own author-chosen column counts. */
@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .mosaic-grid:not(.mosaic-grid--uniform) {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    grid-auto-rows: 180px;
  }
}

/* At ~768px and down, tall portrait crops start to read poorly inside a
   landscape grid. Switch the whole grid to uniform 1×1 squares in 2
   columns so every tile shares the same crop shape. */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .mosaic-grid:not(.mosaic-grid--uniform) {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    grid-auto-rows: auto;
  }

  .mosaic-grid:not(.mosaic-grid--uniform) .mosaic-tile--sm,
  .mosaic-grid:not(.mosaic-grid--uniform) .mosaic-tile--md,
  .mosaic-grid:not(.mosaic-grid--uniform) .mosaic-tile--tall,
  .mosaic-grid:not(.mosaic-grid--uniform) .mosaic-tile--lg {
    grid-column: span 1;
    grid-row: span 1;
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  }

  /* Uniform mode: honor the block's "Columns on mobile" setting. */
  .mosaic-grid--uniform {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--mosaic-cols-mobile, 1), 1fr);
  }
}

/* Stack to a single column at narrow phone widths (Auto mode only). */
@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .mosaic-grid:not(.mosaic-grid--uniform) {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
   CATEGORY GRID MODE
   Uses the same mosaic-grid and mosaic-tile layout.
   Only difference: .mosaic-tile__tag shows tile_name
   instead of a brand theme (handled in PHP).
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ */

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESEARCH-GRID MODE — 5-tile editorial grid
   Mirrors lp-rgrid from the brand landing page,
   namespaced for reuse as a block.
══════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.mosaic-rgrid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
  grid-auto-rows: clamp(150px, 17vw, 230px);
  gap: 6px;
}

.mosaic-rgrid__tile--a { grid-column: span 5; grid-row: span 2; }
.mosaic-rgrid__tile--b { grid-column: span 4; grid-row: span 2; }
.mosaic-rgrid__tile--c { grid-column: span 3; grid-row: span 2; }
.mosaic-rgrid__tile--d { grid-column: span 7; grid-row: span 2; }
.mosaic-rgrid__tile--e { grid-column: span 5; grid-row: span 2; }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .mosaic-rgrid { grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); }
  .mosaic-rgrid__tile--a { grid-column: span 6; }
  .mosaic-rgrid__tile--b { grid-column: span 3; }
  .mosaic-rgrid__tile--c { grid-column: span 3; }
  .mosaic-rgrid__tile--d { grid-column: span 6; }
  .mosaic-rgrid__tile--e { grid-column: span 6; }
}
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .mosaic-rgrid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    grid-auto-rows: clamp(220px, 60vw, 300px);
  }
  .mosaic-rgrid__tile--a,
  .mosaic-rgrid__tile--b,
  .mosaic-rgrid__tile--c,
  .mosaic-rgrid__tile--d,
  .mosaic-rgrid__tile--e {
    grid-column: span 1;
    grid-row: span 1;
  }
}

.mosaic-rgrid__tile {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #1a1a1a;
  display: block;
  text-decoration: none;
  outline: none;
}
.mosaic-rgrid__tile:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--wp--preset--color--gold, #fdb515);
}

.mosaic-rgrid__face {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}
.mosaic-rgrid__tile:focus-visible .mosaic-rgrid__face { transform: scale(1.05); }
@media (hover: hover) {
	.mosaic-rgrid__tile:hover .mosaic-rgrid__face { transform: scale(1.05);
	}
}

.mosaic-rgrid__scrim {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,.9) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.45) 45%, rgba(0,0,0,.05) 100%);
}
.mosaic-rgrid--pos-top .mosaic-rgrid__scrim {
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,.9) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.45) 45%, rgba(0,0,0,.05) 100%);
}
.mosaic-rgrid--pos-center .mosaic-rgrid__scrim {
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,.82) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.5) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,.82) 100%);
}

.mosaic-rgrid__body {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.75rem);
  gap: 0.875rem;
  border-top: 3px solid transparent;
}
.mosaic-rgrid--pos-bottom .mosaic-rgrid__body { justify-content: flex-end; }
.mosaic-rgrid--pos-top    .mosaic-rgrid__body { justify-content: flex-start; }
.mosaic-rgrid--pos-center .mosaic-rgrid__body { justify-content: center; }
.mosaic-rgrid__tile:focus-visible .mosaic-rgrid__body {
  border-top-color: var(--wp--preset--color--gold, #fdb515);
}
@media (hover: hover) {
.mosaic-rgrid__tile:hover .mosaic-rgrid__body {
  border-top-color: var(--wp--preset--color--gold, #fdb515);
}
}

.mosaic-rgrid__text {
  font-size: clamp(0.8125rem, 1.15vw, 0.9375rem);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: #fff;
  max-width: 46ch;
}

.mosaic-rgrid__link {
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--wp--preset--color--gold, #fdb515);
  border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor;
  padding-bottom: 2px;
  align-self: flex-start;
  transition: color 0.12s;
}
@media (hover: hover) {
.mosaic-rgrid__tile:hover .mosaic-rgrid__link { color: #fff; }
}

.mosaic-rgrid__footer {
  text-align: right;
  margin-top: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
}
.mosaic-rgrid__cta {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--wp--preset--color--gold, #fdb515);
  border: 2px solid currentColor;
  padding: 0.875em 1.75em;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.12s, color 0.12s;
}
.mosaic-rgrid__cta:focus-visible {
  background: var(--wp--preset--color--gold, #fdb515);
  color: #000;
  outline: none;
}
@media (hover: hover) {
.mosaic-rgrid__cta:hover {
  background: var(--wp--preset--color--gold, #fdb515);
  color: #000;
  outline: none;
}
}

/* Container override to force side-by-side horizontal scrolling */
.story-carousel {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
  overflow-x: auto !important;
  scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  gap: 0 !important; /* Removes gap between slides so only 1 fits */
  padding-bottom: 1.5rem !important;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

/* Force each direct child card wrapper to take 100% full width */
.story-carousel > .wp-block-group {
  flex: 0 0 100% !important; /* Full width for 1 card view */
  max-width: 100% !important;
  min-width: 100% !important;
  scroll-snap-align: start;
  scroll-snap-stop: always; /* Prevents skipping cards when flinging/scrolling quickly */
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Maintain full width across tablet and desktop */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .story-carousel > .wp-block-group {
    flex: 0 0 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
  }
}

//* Prevent inner content overflow */
.story-carousel .wp-block-columns {
  width: 100%;
}

/* Custom scrollbar styling */
.story-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar {
  height: 6px;
}
.story-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: #f1f1f1;
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.story-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #c1c1c1;
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.story-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: #a8a8a8;
}
/* Hide default scrollbar for a cleaner slider look */
.story-carousel {
  -ms-overflow-style: none;  /* IE and Edge */
  scrollbar-width: none;  /* Firefox */
}
.story-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none; /* Chrome, Safari, Opera */
}

/* Dots Navigation Container */
.carousel-dots {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

/* Individual Dot Style */
.carousel-dot {
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: #ccc;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}

.carousel-dot:hover {
  transform: scale(1.15);
}

/* Active Dot State */
.carousel-dot.active {
  background-color: #000; /* Change to your primary theme color */
  transform: scale(1.25);
}

    <!-- GTM (routes through Stape sGTM at webanalytics.umbc.edu): analytics loads
         by default (US tiered model), deferred until first user interaction.
         prefs-bar.js sets window.umbcConsentGranted and calls window.umbcLoadTracking().
         Returning "essential only" (opted-out) visitors never trigger this block.
         Crazy Egg is intentionally NOT bundled here — it loads separately and last,
         after GTM and the window 'load' event, via umbcLoadCrazyEgg() below. -->
    <script>
    (function(){
      // Consent model flags read by prefs-bar.js (tiered model: analytics-default / ads opt-out).
      window.umbcUseNewConsent = true;

      // ── Region (EU/EEA/UK vs everyone else) — decided HERE, in the browser ──
      // Pages are cached at the CDN for 24h and the CDN passes no country header
      // to PHP, so the server cannot tell an EU visitor from a US one (and
      // umbc_consent_region() in functions.php therefore stays 'us'). Nothing
      // here makes a network request. The visitor's IANA time zone is a
      // cache-safe proxy: it errs toward EU (Europe/Moscow, Istanbul, Zurich
      // count), which is only ever the stricter banner. Must run before the
      // Consent Mode default below and before paint (the class it sets on <html>
      // picks which banner variant CSS shows, so nothing flashes).
      //   ?umbc_region=eu|us  test override, kept for the tab session only.
      var umbcRegion = 'us';
      try {
        var umbcOv = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('umbc_region');
        if (umbcOv === 'eu' || umbcOv === 'us') {
          try { sessionStorage.setItem('umbc_region_override', umbcOv); } catch (e) {}
        } else {
          try { umbcOv = sessionStorage.getItem('umbc_region_override'); } catch (e) { umbcOv = null; }
        }
        if (umbcOv === 'eu' || umbcOv === 'us') {
          umbcRegion = umbcOv;
        } else {
          var umbcTz = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || '';
          if (/^Europe\//.test(umbcTz) || [
            'Atlantic/Reykjavik', 'Atlantic/Canary', 'Atlantic/Faroe', 'Atlantic/Faeroe', 'Atlantic/Madeira',
            'Atlantic/Azores', 'Arctic/Longyearbyen', 'Africa/Ceuta',
            'Asia/Nicosia', 'Asia/Famagusta',
            'Iceland', 'Portugal', 'Poland', 'Eire', 'GB', 'GB-Eire', 'CET', 'MET', 'EET', 'WET'
          ].indexOf(umbcTz) !== -1) { umbcRegion = 'eu'; }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      window.umbcRegion = umbcRegion;
      if (umbcRegion === 'eu') { document.documentElement.classList.add('umbc-region-eu'); }

      // Consent record (EU only): prefs-bar.js writes umbc_consent_meta = "v1|<ISO date>"
      // beside umbc_cookie_consent whenever an EU visitor makes a choice. An EU
      // visitor whose choice has no matching record (made under the old worldwide
      // "Got it" banner, or under an older policy version) has not given valid
      // consent, so their saved value is ignored and they are asked again.
      // Bump the version to re-ask everyone.
      window.umbcConsentPolicy = 'v1';
      var umbcCk = function(n){
        var m = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(?:^|;\\s*)' + n + '=([^;]*)'));
        return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '';
      };
      var umbcSaved = umbcCk('umbc_cookie_consent');
      if (umbcRegion === 'eu' && umbcCk('umbc_consent_meta').split('|')[0] !== window.umbcConsentPolicy) {
        umbcSaved = '';
      }

      // ── Google Consent Mode v2 (Basic) ─────────────────────────────────────
      // Tell Google's own tags (GA4, Google Ads) what the visitor agreed to.
      // Our gating is unchanged: GTM still loads only with analytics consent and
      // ad tags are still stopped by GTM's "Block - ads not consented" trigger.
      // This only makes the choice visible to Google, which EEA ad measurement
      // requires. Must run before GTM loads (it does: GTM is deferred below) and
      // must mirror computeState() in prefs-bar.js exactly, or GA4 cookies break.
      // prefs-bar.js sends the matching 'update' calls when a choice changes.
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.gtag = window.gtag || function(){ window.dataLayer.push(arguments); };
      (function(){
        var saved = umbcSaved;
        var an, ad;
        if (saved === 'all')            { an = true;  ad = true;  }
        else if (saved === 'analytics') { an = true;  ad = false; }
        else if (saved === 'essential') { an = false; ad = false; }
        else { an = ad = (window.umbcRegion !== 'eu'); } // US default-on; EU opt-in pending
        if (navigator.globalPrivacyControl === true) { ad = false; }
        var g = function(on){ return on ? 'granted' : 'denied'; };
        window.gtag('consent', 'default', {
          analytics_storage:  g(an),
          ad_storage:         g(ad),
          ad_user_data:       g(ad),
          ad_personalization: g(ad)
        });
      })();

      // ── First-touch source capture (local only — pre-consent safe) ─────────
      // The hard-gate consent defers GA4 until the visitor accepts. For NEW
      // visitors that loses the original traffic source, so GA4 logs the session
      // as (not set). Remember the FIRST referrer + campaign params of the
      // session in sessionStorage (no cookie, nothing transmitted, cleared on
      // tab close) so we can replay them to GA4 on the first post-consent hit.
      // EU: storing this is not strictly necessary, so it waits for an analytics
      // opt-in (ePrivacy). EU visitors who opt in mid-visit lose first-touch source.
      try {
        if ((umbcRegion !== 'eu' || umbcSaved === 'all' || umbcSaved === 'analytics') &&
            !sessionStorage.getItem('umbc_landing_src')) {
          var umbcQS = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
          sessionStorage.setItem('umbc_landing_src', JSON.stringify({
            ref:          document.referrer || '',
            utm_source:   umbcQS.get('utm_source')   || '',
            utm_medium:   umbcQS.get('utm_medium')   || '',
            utm_campaign: umbcQS.get('utm_campaign') || '',
            utm_term:     umbcQS.get('utm_term')     || '',
            utm_content:  umbcQS.get('utm_content')  || '',
            gclid:        umbcQS.get('gclid')        || ''
          }));
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      // The cookie banner is rendered visible-by-default (so automated checks
      // and no-JS visitors detect the disclaimer). For visitors who already
      // made a choice, hide it synchronously here — before paint — so cached
      // pages don't flash the banner. cookie-banner.js handles the rest.
      if (umbcSaved) {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('umbc-has-consent');
      }
      var gtmSrc = "https:\/\/webanalytics.umbc.edu\/8rvx9pudelsov.js?4=HwtOKzEpWDssJTArNTMzVgBSQUJUQhEeSxoeDgZKEBQD";
      var gtmId  = "GTM-KZJCGPWF";

      var gtmLoaded = false;
      function umbcLoadTracking(){
        if(gtmLoaded) return;
        // Only run if consent has been granted (set by cookie-banner.js)
        if(!window.umbcConsentGranted) return;
        gtmLoaded = true;
        // Replay the captured first-touch source into the dataLayer BEFORE GTM
        // initializes, so the GA4 Configuration tag can read these as Data Layer
        // Variables and set page_referrer / campaign_* — attributing new visitors
        // to their true source even though GA4 fired late (post-consent).
        try {
          var umbcLS = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('umbc_landing_src') || '{}');
          window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
          window.dataLayer.push({
            original_referrer:     umbcLS.ref          || undefined,
            original_utm_source:   umbcLS.utm_source   || undefined,
            original_utm_medium:   umbcLS.utm_medium   || undefined,
            original_utm_campaign: umbcLS.utm_campaign || undefined,
            original_utm_term:     umbcLS.utm_term     || undefined,
            original_utm_content:  umbcLS.utm_content  || undefined,
            original_gclid:        umbcLS.gclid        || undefined
          });
        } catch (e) {}
        // GTM web container — full loader src is resolved in PHP per environment
        // (live: Google /gtm.js?id=; dev/test: Stape Custom Loader obfuscated path).
        (function(w,d,s,l,src){w[l]=w[l]||[];w[l].push({'gtm.start':
        new Date().getTime(),event:'gtm.js'});var f=d.getElementsByTagName(s)[0],
        j=d.createElement(s);j.async=true;j.src=src;
        f.parentNode.insertBefore(j,f);
        })(window,document,'script','dataLayer',gtmSrc);
        // Kick off Crazy Egg separately, after the page has settled.
        umbcScheduleCrazyEgg();
      }
      // Expose so cookie-banner.js can call it directly after consent is granted.
      window.umbcLoadTracking = umbcLoadTracking;

      /* ── Crazy Egg: per-page, separate, lowest-priority loader ────────────
         Only loads where an editor has ticked "Enable Crazy Egg recording" on
         the page (post meta umbc_enable_crazyegg → ceEnabled below), AND only
         after consent, after window 'load', and during an idle moment. Crazy
         Egg only records on URLs that have an active Snapshot in the Crazy Egg
         dashboard, so site-wide loading bought nothing on the ~99% of pages we
         don't record — this scopes the script (and its session-replay privacy
         surface) to the handful of pages actually under study. */
      var ceEnabled = false;
      var ceLoaded = false;
      // Crazy Egg = session recording → advertising bucket (umbcAdConsent),
      // NOT the analytics-default bucket. Off for EU/GPC/opt-out.
      function umbcLoadCrazyEgg(){
        if(ceLoaded || !ceEnabled) return;
        if(!window.umbcAdConsent) return;
        ceLoaded = true;
        var ce=document.createElement('script');ce.async=true;
        ce.src='//script.crazyegg.com/pages/scripts/0112/6110.js';
        document.head.appendChild(ce);
      }
      function umbcScheduleCrazyEgg(){
        if(ceLoaded || !ceEnabled || !window.umbcAdConsent) return;
        var idle = window.requestIdleCallback || function(cb){return setTimeout(cb,1);};
        var run  = function(){ idle(umbcLoadCrazyEgg); };
        if(document.readyState === 'complete'){ run(); }
        else { window.addEventListener('load', run, {once:true}); }
      }
      window.umbcLoadCrazyEgg = umbcLoadCrazyEgg;

      // Also bind to user interaction — fires only if umbcConsentGranted is already true
      // (i.e. returning visitor who previously accepted all cookies).
      // Do NOT inject GTM inside the touch itself: it adds scripts/iframes to the DOM, and iOS
      // Safari treats DOM changes between touchstart and click as "the page changed", so it
      // drops that first tap (the "first tap does nothing, second works" bug). Wait until the
      // tap has finished.
      // Keep one permanent no-op touch listener. The {once:true} touchstart listener below is
      // removed by the first scroll, and with no touch listener left on the page iOS Safari
      // swallows the next tap (found in the iOS Simulator: scroll, then tap = nothing happens).
      document.addEventListener('touchstart', function(){}, {passive:true});
      var events=['scroll','click','touchstart','keydown'];
      events.forEach(function(e){
        window.addEventListener(e, function(){ setTimeout(umbcLoadTracking, 1200); }, {once:true,passive:true});
      });
      // Fallback: load after 15s — must exceed Lighthouse's ~10s test window.
      // Still gated by umbcConsentGranted so essential-only visitors stay clean.
      setTimeout(umbcLoadTracking, 15000);
    })();
    </script>

    <style>
/* Per-kind accent drives the bottom border, icon, and button.
   teal = weather, gold = caution, red = crisis (UMBC brand colors).
   Background is a light tint of the accent so text stays dark/readable
   in light mode; dark mode uses a dark tint with light text.
   Always emitted, not just when an alert is active: the banner can be
   injected client-side after this point in the document. */
.emergency-banner {
  --acc: #007176;
  --acc-bg: #e3f1f1;
  --acc-bg-dark: #0b2c2d;
  padding: 14px 0;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  background: var(--acc-bg);
  color: #1a1a1a;
  border-bottom: 4px solid var(--acc);
}

.emergency-banner.emergency-weather { --acc: #007176; --acc-bg: #e3f1f1; --acc-bg-dark: #0b2c2d; } /* teal  */
.emergency-banner.emergency-caution { --acc: #fdb515; --acc-bg: #fff4d6; --acc-bg-dark: #3a2d08; } /* gold  */

<div id="umbc-emergency-mount" data-emergency-signature=""></div>

<script>
/* Rehydrate the banner. The surrounding page may have been cached by the CDN
   for up to 24h, so whatever is (or isn't) in the mount above cannot be
   trusted — re-check against the origin and reconcile. */
(function () {
	var mount = document.getElementById('umbc-emergency-mount');
	if (!mount || !window.fetch) { return; }

	/* Bucket the URL into UMBC_EMERGENCY_TTL-second windows. Everyone loading a
	   page in the same window requests the same URL (so the CDN serves one
	   cached object, keeping origin load flat), and the URL changes when the
	   window rolls, so a long edge TTL cannot pin us to stale data. This makes
	   freshness independent of the Cache-Control header — which matters,
	   because Pantheon's site-wide 604800s default has overridden it before. */
	var ttl = 30;
	var base = "\/wp-json\/umbc\/v1\/emergency";
	function check() {
	var url = base + (base.indexOf('?') === -1 ? '?' : '&') + 't=' + Math.floor(Date.now() / (ttl * 1000));

	fetch(url, {
		credentials: 'omit',
		headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
	})
		.then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
		.then(function (data) {
			if (!data || data.ok !== true) { return; }
			var current = mount.getAttribute('data-emergency-signature') || '';
			var next = data.signature || '';
			/* Identical to what's already rendered: leave the DOM alone so
			   aria-live doesn't re-announce an alert the user already saw. */
			if (current === next) { return; }
			mount.innerHTML = data.active ? data.html : '';
			mount.setAttribute('data-emergency-signature', next);
		})
		.catch(function () { /* keep whatever was server-rendered */ });
	}

	/* Check on load, then once per window while the tab is visible, and as soon
	   as a hidden tab comes back, so an alert or an all-clear reaches a tab
	   that stays open. Same bucketed URL, so the CDN still absorbs the load. */
	check();
	setInterval(function () {
		if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') { check(); }
	}, ttl * 1000);
	document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
		if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') { check(); }
	});
})();
</script>

    function syncToggles() {
        var dark = isDark();
        toggles.forEach(function (btn) {
            btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(dark));

            html.setAttribute('data-theme', nowDark ? 'dark' : 'light');

            syncToggles();
        });
    });
})();

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        // Convert classic pagination divs to semantic ul
        const navLinksDiv = document.querySelector('div.nav-links');
        if (navLinksDiv && navLinksDiv.parentNode && navLinksDiv.parentNode.tagName === 'NAV') {
            // Create new ul element
            const ul = document.createElement('ul');

            // Copy all attributes from div to ul
            for (let attr of navLinksDiv.attributes) {
                ul.setAttribute(attr.name, attr.value);
            }

            // Process children - wrap them in li tags
            const children = Array.from(navLinksDiv.childNodes);
            children.forEach(function(child) {
                if (child.nodeType === 3) {
                    // Text node - wrap in li
                    if (child.textContent.trim()) {
                        const li = document.createElement('li');
                        li.textContent = child.textContent;
                        ul.appendChild(li);
                    }
                } else if (child.nodeType === 1) {
                    // Element node
                    const li = document.createElement('li');
                    li.appendChild(child.cloneNode(true));
                    ul.appendChild(li);
                }
            });

            // Replace div with ul
            navLinksDiv.parentNode.replaceChild(ul, navLinksDiv);
        }
    });

    window.addEventListener('load', function () {
        // ── Styles ──────────────────────────────────────────────
        var style = document.createElement('style');
        style.textContent = [
            '#umbc-scroll-top {',
            '  position: fixed;',
            '  bottom: 2rem;',
            '  right: 2rem;',
            '  width: 44px;',
            '  height: 44px;',
            '  padding: 0;',
            '  display: flex;',
            '  align-items: center;',
            '  justify-content: center;',
            '  background: #007176;',
            '  color: #fff;',
            '  border: none;',
            '  border-radius: 50%;',
            '  cursor: pointer;',
            '  z-index: 9999;',
            '  opacity: 0;',
            '  visibility: hidden;',
            '  transition: opacity 0.25s ease, visibility 0.25s ease, background 0.2s ease;',
            '  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);',
            '  line-height: 1;',
            '  flex-shrink: 0;',
            '}',
            '#umbc-scroll-top.is-visible {',
            '  opacity: 1;',
            '  visibility: visible;',
            '}',
            '#umbc-scroll-top:hover {',
            '  background: #005a5e;',
            '}',
            '#umbc-scroll-top:focus-visible {',
            '  background: #005a5e;',
            /* The ring sits 2px outside the teal button, on the page: white was 1.04:1
               there (WCAG 2.4.13 needs 3:1). Dark on light pages, white on dark ones. */
            '  outline: 2px solid #1a1a1a;',
            '  outline-offset: 2px;',
            '}',
            '[data-theme="dark"] #umbc-scroll-top:focus-visible {',
            '  outline-color: #fff;',
            '}',
            '#umbc-scroll-top svg {',
            '  pointer-events: none;',
            '  display: block;',
            '  flex-shrink: 0;',
            '}',
        ].join('\n');
        document.head.appendChild(style);

        // ── Logic ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        var btn = document.getElementById('umbc-scroll-top');
        if (!btn) return;

        btn.hidden = false; // remove the HTML hidden attr now that CSS is ready

        function getScrollY() {
            return window.pageYOffset
                || document.documentElement.scrollTop
                || document.body.scrollTop
                || 0;
        }

        var lastVisible = false;
        function toggle() {
            var visible = getScrollY() > 300;
            if (visible === lastVisible) return; // no change, skip DOM write
            lastVisible = visible;
            if (visible) {
                btn.classList.add('is-visible');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            } else {
                btn.classList.remove('is-visible');
                btn.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
            }
        }

        toggle(); // check once immediately after load
        window.addEventListener('scroll', toggle, { passive: true });
        document.addEventListener('scroll', toggle, { passive: true });

        // rAF poll — catches scroll on containers that don't bubble to window/document
        // (e.g. html/body overflow setups). Runs cheaply: only writes DOM on state change.
        (function rafPoll() {
            toggle();
            requestAnimationFrame(rafPoll);
        })();

        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            // Scroll whichever container is actually scrolled back to top.
            var scrolled = [document.documentElement, document.body].filter(function(el) {
                return el.scrollTop > 0;
            });
            if (scrolled.length) {
                scrolled.forEach(function(el) {
                    el.scrollTo ? el.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }) : (el.scrollTop = 0);
                });
            } else {
                window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
            // Move focus to the top of the page after scrolling.
            var target = document.getElementById('skip-to-content')
                      || document.querySelector('main, [role="main"], h1, body');
            if (target) {
                target.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
                target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }
        });

        btn.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                e.preventDefault();
                btn.click();
            }
        });
    });
